name: amount-hint-clamp-more
description: Watering amount for a 15 cm let_top_dry pot (350 ml) when the low clamp bit and moved 1.5 into the amount: 500 ml, and the hint says 'more'.
why: The 15 cm pot case gives 333 ml for let_top_dry in a 15 cm pot (amount-hint-15cm-pot); times the amount factor 1.5 = 500 ml, shown rounded to 50 ml. adjust 'more' because the factor is at least 1.1.
